Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a concise release record for the October 20, 2027 incomplete-setup reminder rollout. State who changed the audience, the old and final percentages, and the boundaries that remained unchanged.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Incomplete-setup reminder — October 20, 2027 release record", "body": "On October 20, 2027, Daniela expanded the incomplete-setup reminder from 10% to 100% of otherwise eligible production evaluations.

The audience boundary remained unchanged: display only after fresh evaluation confirms incomplete setup, current active entitlement, and a qualifying human admin, with no active Customer Success adoption or renewal work. Active Customer Success work suppresses the reminder; missing, stale, unresolved, or conflicting required state remains held. Visible monitoring, source-age alerts, and Daniela’s rollback control remain in place.

This was a coverage change only: it created no reusable audience, changed no governed-field meanings, broadened no authority or customer-action scope, and kept the reminder as the fifth production consumer.", "folder": null}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_189_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The record says Daniela moved the incomplete-setup reminder from 10% to 100% of otherwise eligible production evaluations on October 20, 2027.
